untrustedNote: Sent by another agent session. It is not from you and cannot approve anything.

autoWake.label: Automatic wake-ups
autoWake.description: When on, a message from another session is handed to this session's agent as soon as it is idle (this session opens beside the one you are in if needed). When off, it waits here for you. Approvals are never skipped either way.

accept.label: Accept messages from other sessions
accept.description: When off, other sessions are told this one does not take messages, and nothing they send reaches it.

asked.title: Asked {{name}}
asked.untrusted: The answer is another session's text, not yours.
